claim: For three representative normal-club shots (straight, draw, fade), the portable recovered core reproduces the original Sensible Golf Windows v1.014 live-player launch, clear-air flight, generic flat-surface landing, bounce, roll and final rest exactly at zero tolerance.

sources.observation: Original live-player machine code executed under 32-bit x86 Unicorn; terrain lookup controlled to generic surface code 0 only.
Zero-tolerance traces: straight_1w 153 samples, draw_mid 131 samples, fade_high 111 samples; all state fields and landing/rest events matched exactly.

notes: Compared fields: X, Y, height, vertical force, horizontal force, direction, swing adjuster, adjusted power. This verifies the controlled generic-flat path, not yet every terrain, hazard, green or cup rule.
